QuestInfo.name: [Magatia's Secret] Getting in the Way of Alcadno
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2111008##k, an alchemist from Zenumist, seems to have a plan in store. Now that I'm Zenumist, I should help him out, right? I better go see #p2111008# immediately.
QuestInfo.1: Zenumist is in conflict with Alcadno... I knew that, but I never thought he'd ask me for a favor like this! Anyway, since #p2111008# made the request, I'd better follow through with it, or I may be in trouble. I'll have to destroy #r20 of the Alcadnos's #o5110300#k. \n\n#o5110300#  #r#a33081#
QuestInfo.2: I destroyed the #o5110300#s that Alcadnos have been working on, at the request of #p2111008#. Hmmm... Was I allowed to do this? Why do Zenumist and Alcadno have such a huge conflict between them?

0.0: Hey, aren't you the rookie alchemist that helped me make the Mana Rock the other day? What are you working on these days...? If you aren't that busy, then do you want to help out on this project? What? You want to know what this project is? Well... it's a secret, so I'll tell you only if you promise me you'll do it.
0.1: You may be a rookie, but you know the basics, right? That Zenumist and Alcadno aren't really friendly. That's why... I was wondering if we can do something that will really irk them. Hahaha... sounds like fun, no?
0.2: Go to the basement of the Alcadno Society building, and you'll see a bunch of devices the Alcadnos made. They are called #r#o5110300##k... Our 'job' is to destroy about #r20#k of them. Oh, to see the look on those Alcadnos's faces, hahaha...\r\n#b(Accept to move to the next quest location.)#k

no.0: Hmm... Since you don't want to partake in it, oh well... I guess you still have a long way to go before becoming a true Zenumist.

1.0: Ah, how did it go? Did you get all 20 #o5110300#s? Ahahahaha! Beautiful. I'm sure those Alcadnos are fuming right about now. Don't feel bad about it. Compared to what they've done to us, it's nothing!

mob.0: Hmm... You haven't destroyed those #r20 #o5110300#s#k yet? I hope it's not guilt holding you back. Compared to what the Alcadnos have done to us, this is nothing!
